# Research — the free toolchain

Survey date: 2026-10-27. Goal: an animated, low-poly Thai ghost 3D
character for Unity at ~0 budget (buying animated horror assets is the
problem we're engineering around).

**Scope update (2026-10-27, plan v2):** the pipeline narrowed to
**Blender only** — models, rigs and animations are generated by
headless scripts. Mixamo / Cascadeur / FreeMoCap below remain valid
research but are **not used** in the current build (mocap explicitly
dropped by the user; Mixamo needs interactive browser login). They're
kept here as the documented "richer animation later" options.

**Verdict up front:** a fully free, proven pipeline exists —
Blender (model) → Mixamo (rig + stock animations) → Cascadeur /
FreeMoCap (custom motion) → FBX → Unity. Paid tools are optional
accelerators, not requirements. No free ready-made Thai ghost model
(Krasue / Nang Nak) was found on Sketchfab or itch.io as of the survey
date, so building (or remixing a CC0 base) is the way.

## AI 3D generation — the quality-upgrade path (added 2026-10-27)

After v0.2 feedback ("model quality not good, parts look
disconnected"), the script-built meshes hit their ceiling: lathe +
sphere assembly reads as primitives, however tuned. Three real
options, best-first for this machine:

### Option A — Hunyuan3D-2mini locally (recommended; hardware fits)

- [Tencent-Hunyuan/Hunyuan3D-2](https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/Hunyuan3D-2)
  (open source) generates a **realistic textured mesh from one
  image** — e.g. the friend's reference photo itself.
- **mini variant needs ~5 GB VRAM** (via
  [ComfyUI](https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/3d/hunyuan3D-2)); this
  machine has an RTX 5060 8 GB → fits. Standard variant wants 12 GB.
- Windows caveat: the repo's custom rasterizer extension can be
  painful to build on Windows; the ComfyUI route or the
  [Hugging Face demo/space](https://huggingface.co/tencent/Hunyuan3D-2)
  are the smoother paths. Weights download is multi-GB; first setup
  ~30–90 min.
- Pipeline fit: AI mesh → Blender (decimate ≤5k tris) → **auto-skin
  to the existing 9-bone rig** (our proximity skinning works on any
  mesh) → existing hand-keyed clips → FBX. The build scripts become
  the rigging/animation stage instead of the modeling stage.

### Option B — Tripo / Meshy API with a free key

- [Tripo](https://studio.tripo3d.ai/workspace/generate) and
  [Meshy](https://www.meshy.ai) both do image→3D on free tiers and
  have REST APIs; Tripo additionally offers humanoid auto-rigging.
- Needs the user to create an account and hand over an API key
  (free credits/month). Scriptable headlessly after that.

### Option C — keep the procedural models

- Zero new dependencies, fully reproducible, already rigged and
  animated. Quality ceiling as seen in v0.3.

## Core stack — all free

| Tool | Role | Cost | Links | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Blender** ✅ in use | Model, rig, animation, FBX export — via headless Python scripts | Free | [blender.org](https://www.blender.org) | The only tool in the v2 pipeline. |
| Mixamo | Auto-rigging + stock animation library | Free w/ Adobe account | [mixamo.com](https://www.mixamo.com) | Still free in 2026; Adobe states the auto-rigger and animation library stay free. *Not used at v2 scope* — needs browser login; our rigs are tiny enough to script. Revisit for richer motion. |
| Cascadeur | AI-assisted keyframe animation, physics, mocap cleanup | Basic plan free | [cascadeur.com](https://cascadeur.com) | *Not used at v2 scope.* Kept as the future option for fancier custom motion. |
| FreeMoCap | Markerless mocap from 1+ webcams → Blender | Free, open source | [repo](https://github.com/freemocap/freemocap) · [Blender add-on](https://github.com/freemocap/freemocap_blender_addon) · [site](https://freemocap.org) | **Dropped** at v2 scope (user: no mocap, indie scale). |

## Optional accelerators — free tiers

| Tool | Role | Links | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Tripo | Image/text → 3D base mesh | [studio.tripo3d.ai](https://studio.tripo3d.ai/workspace/generate) | "Smart Mesh" targets game-ready low-poly output; monthly free credits. AI meshes usually still need decimate/retopo in Blender. |
| Meshy | Image/text → 3D + textures | [meshy.ai](https://www.meshy.ai) | Praised for texture quality. Same retopo caveat. |
| Sketchfab | Reference + CC0 remix bases | [CC0 horror character](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/cc0-horror-game-character-d14367977cf5461fa1855e3bbfb57d48) · [ghost tag](https://sketchfab.com/tags/ghost) | Nothing Thai-ghost specific free; a CC0 female ghost can be remixed into a Mae Nak silhouette. |
| Unity Personal | Target engine | [unity.com](https://unity.com) | Free below the revenue threshold. |

## How-to pointers — the exact bridge steps

- Blender → Unity export checklist (scale, axes, bones):
  [Cinevva guide](https://app.cinevva.com/guides/blender-to-unity-export-checklist),
  [Blender StackExchange thread](https://blender.stackexchange.com/questions/279419/how-to-get-a-rigged-character-from-blender-fbx-unity)
- Video walkthroughs:
  [Rigged characters to Unity/Unreal](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=27woi8FsgAU),
  [Blender animation → Unity](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uWexElqDcaA),
  [Rigify rig → Unity](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vrN9duEoA6g)
- Unity side: import FBX → Rig tab → **Humanoid** so Mecanim
  retargeting works. The classic failure is leaving the rig Generic or
  exporting un-baked animation.

## Licensing notes — read before shipping

- **Mixamo**: auto-rig and animations are free for commercial games,
  no royalties.
- **CC0 assets**: no attribution required (credit is courteous).
- **Folklore**: Krasue, Mae Nak, Pret are folklore — free to use. Do
  not clone one specific film's exact costume/makeup design; keep the
  design generic-folklore to stay clear of a studio's protected
  expression.
- **FreeMoCap**: open source; your captured motion data is yours.
  Check the repo license before redistributing the software itself.
- **Cascadeur / Tripo / Meshy free tiers**: re-check each ToS for
  commercial-use limits at release time — free tiers change.
